verdict.rationale: The get-started docs name official Go, Python and TypeScript SDKs plus a raw HTTP API authenticated with a team-scoped API key (SANDBOX0_TOKEN). The feature docs describe API-driven sandbox lifecycle, file, observability and webhook operations, so the product can be driven programmatically through documented interfaces. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/endpoint reference (all standard OpenAPI paths returned 404), explicit raw HTTP endpoint documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
